summary: Tuesday's session was dominated by broad dollar strength, with the DXY holding above its 30-day average and up 1.2% over two weeks, which kept pressure on gold and pushed it toward 14-day lows. Equities stayed calm as volatility remained below its historical average, while crypto diverged sharply, with Bitcoin holding up far better than Ethereum amid rising short-term volatility.
tweet: A firmer dollar hammered gold on Tuesday while low volatility kept stocks steady and crypto split, Bitcoin outperforming Ethereum.
